source: CRON 20261014: Cornerstone Insurance Plc unaudited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Group 30-Jun-26 column, thousands of naira scaled to naira. Revenue is the printed Insurance revenue; Gross Profit is the printed Insurance service result; Cost of Sales is Revenue less Insurance service result. Operating Expenses is the printed Management expenses; Income Tax is the printed Tax expense. EPS is left blank because the filing kobo row does not reconcile to profit attributable to owners divided by the 18,166,392,725 shares on file. | NGX audited annual report (filed PDF, _ngx_pdf) FY2025 | 2026-11-15: FY2021-FY2023 Revenue filled from the FY2025 annual report Financial Summary - Group (Insurance service revenue). | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the Cornerstone Insurance Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, group column, printed in thousands of naira and stored as absolute naira. Insurance revenue 43,307,830; insurance service expense 17,856,045 plus net expenses from reinsurance contracts held 13,703,311 plus management expenses 5,910,918 gives operating expenses 37,470,274; investment return and net insurance finance expenses sit between the service result and profit before tax; profit before tax 7,740,271 after a minimum tax charge of 171,686; tax expense 332,698; profit for the year 7,407,572. Ties at one thousand rounding. The page prints no earnings per share. | CRON 20261120: FY2024 EPS corrected from 91.0 to 1.42. The 91 was the COMPANY column printed in kobo; the panel stores group figures in naira. Audited FY2024 AFS page 141 (EPS note 36) prints 142 kobo basic and diluted on earnings attributable to owners of 25,583,280 thousand and 18,032,132 thousand shares; page 33 prints group profit for the year 25,893,504 thousand, which is the value this file already stores as Net Profit. Verified at https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/44227_CORNERSTONE_INSURANCE_PLC-_QUARTER_5_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2024_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JUNE_2025.pdf | CRON 20261120 (9M 2026 EPS): 0.35 naira, the printed basic and diluted figure of 35 kobo on page 29 of the Q3 2026 statement, on profit attributable to owners of 12,643,500 thousand. It rests on roughly 36.1 billion shares, twice the 18.0 billion the FY2024 EPS note used, so it is not comparable with the as-filed annual EPS. https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/48290_CORNERSTONE_INSURANCE_PLC-_QUARTER_3_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_OCTOBER_2026.pdf
